description: This file declares functions and constants related to copying files and file descriptors, including error codes and function prototypes for copying file descriptors and files with optional mode and timestamp handling.

methods.name: copy_fd
methods.description: Copies data from one file descriptor to another.

methods.name: copy_file
methods.description: Copies a file from source to destination with specified mode.

methods.name: copy_file_with_time
methods.description: Copies a file along with timestamp information, from source to destination with specified mode.
